payload.title: File:Gojirasaurus scale and skeletal.png
payload.description_html: Scale and skeletal diagram for Gojirasaurus quayi, holotype specimen UCM 47221. Outline and proportions roughly based on Coelophysis, Dilophosaurus, and Zupaysaurus, scaled to the 5.5 meter length estimate published by Carpenter (1997). Apart from the speculative gastralia dimensions, all bones are based on illustrations published by Carpenter (1997) and photos published by Griffin (2019) and the UCM fossil vertebrate collection (https://fossilvertebratesandtraces.colorado.edu/index.php/Detail/vertebrate/54346/subsite/vertebrate#). Right pubis and right scapula are depicted in medial view, other bones are in lateral view.
